response.sql: WITH pairs AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader tr ON tr.tradereg = s.trdref2 GROUP BY s.transref, tr.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS om FROM pairs), kept AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.om AS margin FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.pair_avg > o.om), per_type AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(margin) AS avg_margin FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_margin, avg_analyst_count / AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER () AS relative_to_mean FROM per_type
